risks.risk: Shutter count / heavy wear (affects lifespan and resale). Photos don’t show shutter count.
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo of the shutter count from-camera or via a shutter-count app/site (or a service report).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used camera with unknown shutter count (worst-case: higher wear).

risks.risk: Lens condition (fungus, haze, scratches, oil on blades) and VR functionality not verifiable from these photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of front and rear lens elements in bright light + a short video showing VR stabilization behavior (or a test shot sequence).
risks.if_unproven: Price as if lens may need cleaning/has minor issues; treat VR as unverified.

risks.risk: Sensor dust/fog/scratches (common and not visible here).
risks.proof: A test photo of a blank white wall at f/16 (or similar) showing dust spots, plus a frame at 100% crop.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if sensor may have dust requiring cleaning.

risks.risk: Missing accessories / incomplete kit (battery, charger, caps, strap, manual). Photos only show camera + lens on the box.
risks.proof: A full laid-out photo of every included item (battery, charger, caps, strap, USB cable, manuals).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a partial kit (worst-case: missing one or more key accessories).

risks.risk: Functional faults (focus issues, shutter/IBIS not applicable, but AF/controls, LCD, buttons, ports).
risks.proof: A short video of autofocus locking on a subject + playback of a few images on the rear LCD.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully guaranteed working (worst-case: needs servicing).

proof_requests: Front + rear lens element close-ups (bright light) and a short VR test video.
Sensor dust test shot (white wall at small aperture) with 100% crop.
Photo of all included accessories laid out.
Video showing AF working and rear LCD playback.
response.reason: The photos clearly indicate a Nikon D3300 18-55mm VR II kit, but the seller’s key spec claims and—more importantly—condition/working status (shutter count, sensor/lens health, included accessories) are not verifiable from the provided images. Without those, a safe worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
